extraction.Name: William J. Bordeaux
extraction.NOTES: This document is a sworn statement by William J. Bordeaux, cousin of allottee Peter Bordeaux (page 66), taken before Notary Public Jas. W. Cross on June 17, 1929 (commission expires 4-28-32). William J. Bordeaux states he worked for W. H. Tackett and received a long distance telephone call from Tackett to have Billy Schmidt at Valentine bring a new Ford touring car for Peter Bordeaux; the car was delivered at Kilgore, Nebraska. He states he does not know the details of the transaction except that he saw the car was delivered. This testimony relates to Peter Bordeaux's affidavit dated March 25, 1929, in which Peter Bordeaux stated that William J. Bordeaux acted as Tackett's agent in the purchase of his allotment.
